purpose: Close source-discovery ambiguity for the four G8 central-bank-pricing currencies that remain WITHHELD. This file is governance/evidence only and does not activate runtime data.

policy.rule: Do not retry free-public scraping when the authoritative venue or central bank documents that the homogeneous historical settlement/OIS series requires licensed or fee-based access.

USD.free_public_state: Current/delayed settlement visibility exists, but the homogeneous historical settlement files needed for T-5 are no longer a reproducible free FTP path for the pipeline.
USD.evidence_summary: CME states historical/settlement file access is being moved to DataMine; DataMine historical access is entitlement/authentication based and historical datasets are sold/licensed.
USD.unlock_action: Acquire CME DataMine entitlement (or another directly licensed official CME settlement feed) for the required ZQ contract history.

EUR.free_public_state: Current product pages expose delayed D. Settle values, but the authoritative historical product containing settlement prices for all tradable series is Eurex Market Statistics Offline.
EUR.evidence_summary: Eurex documents Market Statistics Offline as containing opening/high/low/settlement/volume/OI for currently tradable series, and the Trading Files page classifies that product as fee-based via MD+S interactive.
EUR.unlock_action: Acquire Eurex Market Statistics Offline / MD+S access (or an equivalent directly licensed Eurex settlement feed) and validate FST3 current/T-1/T-5 on the same contract basis.

CHF.free_public_state: The public ICE contract page validates the instrument, quarterly expiries and 100-minus-rate convention; reproducible historical/EOD listed-market settlement data is delivered through ICE data services.
CHF.evidence_summary: ICE describes historical and end-of-day Futures Europe data, including settlement values, as delivered through ICE Connect, Consolidated History, Data API and Data Files under its data/licensing framework.
CHF.unlock_action: Acquire ICE historical/EOD entitlement for SA3 settlements (or another directly licensed ICE feed) and validate homogeneous current/T-1/T-5 observations.

NZD.instrument: NZD OIS linked to OCR expectations
NZD.free_public_state: RBNZ publishes OCR, bank-bill and standard swap data, but its monetary-policy publications source the OIS-implied OCR expectation curve from Bloomberg rather than publishing a reproducible daily OIS curve itself.
NZD.evidence_summary: RBNZ explicitly labels the OCR-expectations curve as overnight-indexed-swap pricing and cites Bloomberg as the source. The public RBNZ series are not a clean substitute for this daily OIS curve.
NZD.unlock_action: Use a directly licensed NZD OIS source (for example Bloomberg or another institutional feed with equivalent provenance) and validate homogeneous 3M/6M/12M current/T-1/T-5 observations.

decision.next_dashboard_action: Keep all four WITHHELD and stop recurring public-source probes until a licensed source is intentionally connected. Continue dashboard/model work using ACTIVE pricing currencies and explicit missingness for the four withheld currencies.
